articles.title: England claim historic away victory against Spain under Thomas Tuchel
articles.summary: England produced a brilliant performance to secure a stunning victory away against Spain in what proved to be their finest display under manager Thomas Tuchel. The match featured a thrilling ninety minutes where the visitors dominated the first half before successfully weathering a fierce Spanish comeback in the second period to seal the memorable win.

articles.title: Romelu Lukaku announces retirement from international football with Belgium
articles.summary: Romelu Lukaku has officially called time on his international career with the Belgian national team. The striker stated that he has cherished every single moment and memory created while representing his country on the international stage throughout the years.

articles.title: Vinicius Jr admits Arsenal transfer speculation heavily impacted his form
articles.summary: Real Madrid forward Vinicius Jr has confessed that intense speculation regarding potential interest from Arsenal during the summer transfer window left him feeling truly overwhelmed. The Brazilian star admitted that the constant rumors negatively affected his performances and focus on the pitch for his club.

articles.title: French FA president Philippe Diallo emerges as shock candidate for FIFA job
articles.summary: French Football Federation president Philippe Diallo has unexpectedly emerged as a late contender to challenge Gianni Infantino for the FIFA presidency. Diallo could have his candidacy officially confirmed by UEFA during their executive committee meeting ahead of the upcoming election deadline in March.

articles.title: Mary Earps stars as London City Lionesses hold Arsenal to draw
articles.summary: Arsenal were left frustrated once again in the Women's Super League after playing out an entertaining one-all draw at home against the London City Lionesses. Unlike previous visitors who sat deep, London City came to play and earned a hard-fought point, heavily inspired by an impressive goalkeeping display from Mary Earps.

articles.title: Ronaldinho makes professional football return with Italian club Ravenna
articles.summary: Brazil legend Ronaldinho has made a sensational return to professional football after an eleven-year hiatus, playing the first half for Italian Serie C side Ravenna. The forty-six-year-old started wearing the number ten shirt against local rivals Forli, having previously announced his signing five months prior.

articles.title: Portugal permanently immortalize Cristiano Ronaldo's iconic number seven shirt
articles.summary: Portugal have made a permanent change to their national team kit by preserving the original number seven design to honor Cristiano Ronaldo. The legendary forward recently retired from international duty following a remarkable twenty-three-year career yielding one hundred and forty-six goals across two hundred and forty-six appearances.

articles.title: Crystal Palace reach agreement in principle to appoint Thomas Frank
articles.summary: Crystal Palace have successfully reached an agreement in principle with Thomas Frank to take over as their new head coach. The Premier League club has moved swiftly to secure his services following a managerial vacancy, with the appointment expected to be finalized soon.

articles.title: Ten-man England hold off Spain to top Nations League group
articles.summary: England secured a famous three-two victory over world champions Spain in their Nations League group finale. Despite having Elliot Anderson sent off, Thomas Tuchel's side withstood heavy second-half pressure from the hosts to claim the win and finish top of the group standings.
